Bijjala usurped Kalyani c.1156-57; Chalukya Someshvara IV, from the rump Chalukya realm outside the core, regained the throne c.1181-84. Military recovery and a Kalachuri general's defection rest on secondary leads only; Bijjala's 1167 death followed by unstable successions.

Western Qarakhanid ruler 'Uthman, a Qara Khitay vassal, submitted to the Khwarazmshah 1209-10; after Samarkand's rising he was executed 1212-13 and the khanate ended (Britannica: defeated and extinguished 1211). Qarluq/Oghuz unrest preceded.
